hooks.text: You don't need an expensive SEO subscription anymore. These three plugins turn Claude Code into an SEO tool.
You don't need to pay for expensive SEO tools anymore, because these three plugins turn Claude Code into an SEO expert.
Three plugins that turn Claude Code into an SEO expert.

scripts.body:
The first is GEO Optimizer, which checks your website against the new AI search rules, so ChatGPT, Claude and Google's AI Overviews can actually read your site, and it gives you a score out of a hundred and a list of what to fix.

The second is the Search Console MCP, which connects Claude directly to your Google Search Console, meaning it can study your real search data, find the keywords you're close to ranking for, and tell you exactly what to change to move up.

And finally there's OpenSEO, which is an open source alternative to Ahrefs and Semrush that handles your keyword research, your rank tracking, your backlinks and your site audits, starting at ten US dollars a month.

So if you want to try all three, just comment RANK down below and I'll send you the links directly.
scripts.caption:
You don't need expensive SEO tools anymore. These 3 plugins turn Claude Code into an SEO expert.

- GEO Optimizer checks your site against the new AI search rules and gives you a score out of 100 plus a list of fixes
- the Search Console MCP connects Claude to your real Google search data and finds the keywords you're close to ranking for
- OpenSEO is an open source Ahrefs and Semrush alternative for keyword research, rank tracking and backlinks, from US$10 a month

scripts.title: 4 words that change how ChatGPT answers you

hooks.text: Four words that change how ChatGPT answers you.
These are four words that will 10x your ChatGPT experience.

scripts.body:
Number one is red team. Type this and ChatGPT argues against your plan, so you find the holes first.

Number two is ELI ten. Put it anywhere and ChatGPT explains the whole thing like you're ten years old.

Number three is truth mode. Put this before your prompt and ChatGPT stops agreeing with you and tells you what's wrong.

Number four is Socrates. Add this and ChatGPT teaches you by asking you questions instead of handing you the answer.

For the full list, hit follow and comment MODES.
scripts.caption:
These are 4 words that will 10x your ChatGPT. Put one at the start of your message.

- red team: it argues against your plan, so you find the holes first
- ELI 10: it explains the whole thing like you're 10
- truth mode: it stops agreeing with you and tells you what's wrong
- Socrates: it teaches you by asking questions instead of handing you the answer

scripts.title: 4 GPT-6 prompts that can run parts of your business

hooks.text: Four GPT-6 Astra prompts that can transform your work and business.
These are four GPT-6 prompts that can transform your work and your business.
Four GPT-6 prompts that can run parts of your business.

scripts.body:
Number one is the agent audit. Tell Astra to look at how your business runs and find the tasks you should hand to agents before you hire another person.

Number two is the dashboard. It reads your docs, your Stripe exports and your customer calls, and tells you what's making money and what's wasting time.

Number three is the bill negotiator. Tell it to go through your internet, phone and software bills, jump into each provider's chat support, and get them down or cancel what you're not using.

Number four is nightly QA. It runs your checkout on a phone every night and screenshots anything that's broken.

These are from Greg Isenberg. If you want all nine, hit follow and comment PROMPTS and I'll DM you.
scripts.caption:
4 GPT-6 prompts that can transform your work and your business, from Greg Isenberg's list of 9.

- the agent audit: find the tasks to hand to agents before you hire another person
- the dashboard: it reads your docs, Stripe exports and customer calls and shows what makes money
- the bill negotiator: it chats with each provider to get your bills down or cancel what you don't use
- nightly QA: it runs your checkout on a phone every night and screenshots anything broken
